# openwrt_dhcp_odhcpd (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt DHCPv6 (odhcpd) settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `leasefile` (String) Lease file path for DHCPv6.
- `leasetrigger` (String) Script to run on lease changes.
- `loglevel` (Number) Log level (0-8).
- `maindhcp` (Boolean) Run odhcpd as DHCPv6 server on interface without RA.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: dhcp/odhcpd.
